title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Training Note: Settlement Courtesy Rate for Automatic Refills
content:
## Training note: automatic refills at settlement

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy member who settles the past-due amount in full, a settlement courtesy reduction is given at the sum of its courtesy rates, one of which is an automatic-refill rate: 1 percent when the member is enrolled in automatic refills and two or more automatic refill orders were placed less than 12 whole months before the handling date, half a percent (0.5 percent) when the member is enrolled with exactly one such order, and nothing otherwise. The courtesy rates are added together and applied once to the past-due amount, and only that result is rounded to the nearest cent.

### Questions answered

**What shows enrollment?** The automatic refill enrollment recorded on the home delivery account.

**Which orders count?** Placed orders whose origin is an automatic refill, dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date.

**Does a member who is not enrolled earn the rate for past automatic refill orders?** No.

### Rate table

| Enrolled | Automatic refill orders in the 12-month span | Automatic-refill rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | 1 percent |
| Yes | exactly 1 | 0.5 percent |
| Yes | none | nothing |
| No | any | nothing |
